name: Death by Scorn

frame.name: Heavy Burst
frame.description: Fires a hard-hitting, two-round burst. Slightly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming.

perks.name: Shortspec SAS
perks.description:
Balanced Sidearm sight. 
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Ricochet Rounds
perks.description:
Rounds ricochet off hard surfaces. 
  •  Increases stability 
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Headseeker
perks.description: Body shots landed with this weapon increase precision damage and aim assist for a short time. Body shots landed while the perk is active refresh the time.

perks.name: Full Auto Trigger System
perks.description: Holding down the trigger will fire this weapon at full auto.

flavor: "The Barons fight together." —Elykris, transl. from Eliksni
